Seed the global dqrng stream for one gamete (Scheme A)

Source: R/recombination_helpers.R
dot-seed_gamete_stream.Rd

Seed the global dqrng stream for one gamete (Scheme A)

Usage

.seed_gamete_stream(base_seed, sid)

Arguments

base_seed

Integer base seed for the whole add_offspring() call.

sid

Integer stream id from .gamete_stream_id().

Value

Invisibly NULL. Sets the dqrng generator kind + seed as a side effect; subsequent dqrng::dqrunif() draws consume this gamete's stream.
